name: Peacefair PZEM-004T (Modbus-RTU)
doc_revision: PDF titled 'PZEM-004T-Datasheet-user-manual' (author Pzem, 7 pages, created 2019-04): 'PZEM-004T AC communication module', PZEM-004T-10A / PZEM-004T-100A. The document does not say 'v3.0' in the text I could read.
notes: Built only from the datasheet above. Addressing: the doc gives protocol register addresses (0x0000-0x0009 for FC04 measurements, 0x0001-0x0002 for FC03/FC06 parameters), so address_base 0 and no conversion. Serial: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity (doc section 2.1). Slave address range 0x01-0xF7 (0x00 broadcast, 0xF8 general address); default slave address is not stated. 32-bit values (current, power, energy) are split into LOW 16 bits first, HIGH 16 bits second (doc table 'low 16 bits' at the lower address; worked example 0x000003E8 = 1.000 A is consistent), hence word_order 'little'. Doc example reads all 10 registers (0x0000-0x0009) in one FC04 request. Writable via plain FC06 per the doc: 0x0001 power alarm threshold (1 LSB = 1 W) and 0x0002 Modbus-RTU address (0x0001-0x00F7); I marked both rw although the task brief suggested address/reset might not be plain writes - in THIS datasheet the address IS a plain FC06 write to holding register 0x0002 (a changed address needs the master to switch to the new address). The reset-energy command (function code 0x42, frame = address + 0x42 + CRC) and the calibration command (0x41, factory use only, address 0xF8, password 0x3721) are NOT register writes and are NOT included. The datasheet is internally inconsistent about the interface (section 1.8/2.1 say RS485, section 5.1 describes a passive TTL interface needing 5V/RX/TX/GND). Some forum reports say multi-register reads are not supported on certain units; the datasheet shows one. Not verified against a physical device.

points.name: Current
points.note: Doc: low 16 bits at 0x0001, high 16 bits at 0x0002; 1 LSB = 0.001 A.

points.name: Active power
points.note: Doc: low 16 bits at 0x0003, high at 0x0004; 1 LSB = 0.1 W.

points.name: Active energy
points.note: Doc: low 16 bits at 0x0005, high at 0x0006; 1 LSB = 1 Wh (range 0-9999.99 kWh). Reset only via function code 0x42 (not a register write; not included).

points.name: Alarm status
points.note: Doc: 0xFFFF is alarm, 0x0000 is not alarm.

points.name: Power alarm threshold
points.note: Doc section 2.4: holding register 0x0001, 1 LSB = 1 W, read with FC03, written with FC06. No limits stated.

points.name: Modbus address
points.note: Doc: holding register 0x0002, range 0x0001-0x00F7, written with FC06 (plain register write in this datasheet). Takes effect for subsequent requests.
